scope: Verify four previously unhashed textbook figures from PDF sources. Pin the existing published PNGs without replacing them. Keep source origin and redistribution status separate.

review.preservation: No reader content, image bytes, navigation, or built output changed. The digest check covered 310 manifest textbook pages, 1189 registered file matches and 33 older files without hashes. It found no missing registry rows or differing image bytes.
review.licenseLimit: InternVL 2.5 and ImageBind remain unconfirmed for redistribution; local preview still uses both. Qwen2-VL Figure 11 was located in arXiv v1 Appendix A.1, but the PDF was not retrieved and the record has no reuse grant; it was not pinned in this pass.
review.release: Local only; no push or deploy.
